firewall_scan_nhl_science_code.interpretation: hits are comments or the over-or-under label of fixed-threshold picks; none is a model input. Model feature columns containing any market-price term: none

hockey_model_or_recent_average_extrapola: EXTRAPOLATION OF RECENT AVERAGES: no availability, role, PP, goalie or opportunity-then-efficiency structure exists; boosted trees combine rolling means with coarse team margin.

goalie_saves.betting_market_dependence: none as input; threshold 25+; gate failed, market not served
goalie_saves.goalie_handling: this IS the goalie model; starter probability absent
goalie_saves.inputs: goalie's own rolling saves/shots against/save pct plus opponent shots-for running average and team margin
goalie_saves.role_toi_assumption: population restricted to target-game TOI >= 1800 s (POSTGAME selection)

moneyline.inputs: team and opponent cumulative goal margin, win rate, goals for/against, games played, home flag

points.efficiency: none separated (no goals vs assists split)

shots_on_goal.betting_market_dependence: none as input; threshold 3+ is a fixed round number
shots_on_goal.efficiency: none separated: no shooting-percentage layer; SOG is the target
shots_on_goal.feature_timing: strictly earlier games (D-1 as-of); team state week-bucketed, using only earlier weeks
shots_on_goal.injury_availability: none: no injury, scratch, line, PP or lineup input; eligibility is stats-based only
shots_on_goal.inputs: same-season prior-game SOG means (season, last 3, last 5), prior TOI means, shots per 60, opponent running average of SOG allowed, home flag, games played, team/opponent goal margin
shots_on_goal.opponent_adjustment: raw running average of shots the opponent has allowed (no league normalisation, no home/away split, no shot-quality)
shots_on_goal.role_toi_assumption: none explicit; recent-3 and season TOI are inputs; eligibility floor prior-3 mean TOI >= 480 s
shots_on_goal.uncertainty: Platt calibration of one threshold probability; no distribution
